Next, Boris separates these remaining 92 pieces into 4 equal portions. Each portion would therefore have \(92 / 4 = 23\) pieces.

Then, he takes out 3 pieces from each of the four bowls. So, from each bowl, 3 pieces end up being taken out, leaving each bowl with \(23 - 3 = 20\) pieces in total,

The average before considering separate counts is thus equal to half of each subset which was already separated evenly among all bowls before Boris took any candies:

\[
\frac{23}{4}=\frac{23*3}{12}=6.5 \text {candies per bowl}

\[ Contribution per person = \frac{\text{Total Tips}}{\text{Number of People}} = \frac{12}{3} \]

Hence,
\[ \text{Contribution per person} = 4 \]

Therefore, the recommended amount for each person to contribute towards a 20% tip is $\boxed{4}$.<|im_end|>
